current_parent_stock_extraction.method: Sort the module population in the verified upstream manifest by parent Git source byte size and then module name. Include the largest 32. Divide the rest into 24 equal-count groups. Take the first 20 module names per group by SHA-256 of stock-capacity-1018-v1: followed by that name. Use stock leantar on each authenticated archive and sum every extracted regular file. Weight each group by its population. The estimated sampling error uses the finite-population correction within each group. The scope excludes package trees, checked-out sources, filesystem allocation, and temporary setup products.

current_candidate.maintainer_command: gh workflow run build-pr.yml --repo leanprover-community/riemann-hypothesis --ref main -f mode=build -f pr_number=879

prior_parent_stock_extraction.method: Order the complete archive population by compressed size. Include the largest 40. Split the remaining rows into 32 equally sized groups. Take 32 modules from each group by SHA-256 rank of stock-size-sample-v1: followed by the module name. Restore those LTARs with stock leantar. Weight each group by its population. Exclude source files, package outputs, temporary setup files and filesystem allocation overhead.

conclusion: The completed bounded job covers its declared roots. Nine default targets require a separate ordinary Lake build. The community full-build workflow accepts the command in current_candidate.maintainer_command.
